north_star.objective: Build a literature-grounded, construct-valid, reproducible project-month panel dataset and a Stata-ready econometric analysis package for objective measures of OSS project performance using only free public data.
prohibited_proxy_progress: number of raw URLs fetched without direct model relevance

diagnosis: paper-goal alignment was not checked before each technical stage
identity-validation engineering became a dominant workstream before panel-data requirements were frozen
minimum analyzable sample and project-period target were not locked early
progress metrics rewarded technical completion rather than analysis readiness
too many micro-stages and handoffs increased coordination cost
no explicit timebox/stop-loss existed for low-yield acquisition paths

evidence_readiness_levels.ERL5: Stata model estimates and diagnostics locked

management_rules.stage_timebox_rule: If a stage exceeds its control timebox without satisfying its exit criteria, stop and redesign; do not extend by default.
management_rules.task_value_rule: Every task must reduce a named research uncertainty or produce a required analysis artifact.
management_rules.data_rule: Bulk public structured data first; targeted crawler/API only for construct-critical gaps.
management_rules.model_rule: Panel-data econometric regression in Stata; no SEM/PLS-SEM/latent-variable modeling unless user later explicitly changes direction.
management_rules.change_control: No metric/sample/model change for result-seeking after formal freeze; exploratory changes must be labeled and audited.
stop_loss: No full-frame 18,827 identity validation unless sample-design audit proves necessity.
No additional crawler engineering solely for completeness.
No new micro-stage unless it maps to one recovery-stage deliverable.
No manuscript drafting before ERL6 unless user explicitly requests otherwise.

recovery_stages.name: Literature Re-Anchor + Sample-Size Decision
exit_criteria: sample target justified from literature + panel inference needs
working unit fixed as OSS project-month

recovery_stages.name: Research Design + Indicator Contract Freeze
exit_criteria: every variable has construct meaning, formula, source, time aggregation and alternative explanations
no convenience metric accepted as performance
model is estimable from public data

recovery_stages.name: Bulk Panel Acquisition
recovery_stages.strategy: OpenDigger/OSS Compass structured bulk data first; targeted Gitee/GitHub API only for R2-defined gaps
exit_criteria: required project count reached after attrition

recovery_stages.name: Stata Baseline Panel Analysis
exit_criteria: no post-hoc metric redefinition for significance

recovery_stages.name: Robustness + Evidence Sufficiency Lock
outputs: count/duration model alternatives where data-generating process requires
exit_criteria: core findings stable or instability explicitly bounded
all manuscript claims traceable to data/code/output

prohibited: formal Stata estimation before R2/R4 gates
